schemas.name: RAW_TELEMETRY
schemas.comment: Raw event firehose. RAW_EVENTS is the single client telemetry stream; 6 of the other 8 tables here are deterministic session-sampled projections of it (marked [DERIVED VIEW]), and 1 further projection lives elsewhere (SESSION_LEVEL_EVENTS). CLIENT_ERROR_EVENTS and RESOURCE_FLOW_EVENTS are NOT sampled -- computed from the full stream.

schemas.name: EXPENSES

tables.name: AD_SPEND_DAILY
tables.comment: Daily marketing spend by game, channel, and country. Channels present: adjoe, applovin, google_uac, meta, unity_ads. By game -- combo_fighter: meta; domino_delights: adjoe, applovin, google_uac, meta, unity_ads; zombie_match_3d: applovin, meta, unity_ads. Spend runs 2024-09-01 to 2026-02-09 (attribution MMP = Singular). No blended CPI is quoted: compute it from these rows for the window you care about, because a single blended figure hides a 3x spread across channels and months.

columns.name: day1_roas

tables.name: INSTALL_EVENTS
tables.comment: Individual install events, 31,210 rows: Domino Delights 22,980, Zombie Match 3D 7,329, Combo Fighter 901. Lifetime distinct players are in DIM_PLAYER. Combo Fighter runs 2025-12-27 to 2026-02-09 (615 paid / 286 organic); no IAP sales recorded for this title, though a store is present - see IAP_TRANSACTIONS. Domino Delights spans three phases: closed alpha from 2023-11-01 (internal testers, pre-launch), unannounced Google Play availability from ~2024-08, and the US soft launch 2025-04-11. 3,784 of its installs predate the US soft launch, so the earliest install date for this title is not its launch date.

tables.name: IAP_TRANSACTIONS
tables.comment: Individual in-app purchase records, 977 rows (2024-02-23 to 2026-02-09). By game: domino_delights 976, zombie_match_3d 1. SKUs present: bundle.tier2.abandoned_backpack, dd_coins_large, dd_coins_medium, dd_coins_mega, dd_coins_small, dd_remove_ads, dd_starter_pack. Titles absent from this table recorded no purchases; absence here means no sales, not the absence of a store. NET of refunds: ANALYTICS.MONETIZATION.STORE_TRANSACTIONS holds 993 gross receipts = 977 completed + 16 refunded ($125.84); the refunded ones are excluded here. The two tables share transaction_id, so this is a strict subset - use that table for receipt counts and this one for revenue.

tables.name: PLAYER_DAILY_PROGRESS
tables.comment: Per-player daily snapshot: level reached, sessions, coins, boosters, levels attempted/completed, purchase flag. coins_earned is what play paid out; coins bought from the store arrive as iap_grant rows in RESOURCE_FLOW_EVENTS and are not counted here. coins_spent and boosters_used count purchases at each game's shipped booster prices, so a player-day with no affordable purchase reads zero, and boosters_used is zero throughout for Combo Fighter, which ships none. made_purchase is reconciled against IAP_TRANSACTIONS at the game-date grain. Holds 183,033 player-days over 31,210 distinct players, against 31,210 installs lifetime -- a player appears here only on days they actually played. Aggregated upstream of the retained event tables. RAW_GAME_EVENTS and STG_EVENTS_ENRICHED retain a 1:8 session sample, and PROGRESSION_EVENTS, SESSION_LEVEL_EVENTS and AD_IMPRESSION_EVENTS a 1:16 sample, so a recount from those tables will not match these totals.

columns.name: player_id
columns.comment: renamed player key; joins to PLAYER_DAILY_PROGRESS.player_id

columns.name: current_level
columns.comment: Highest level unlocked

tables.name: DAILY_ACTIVE_USERS
tables.comment: Daily aggregated user metrics per game and platform. Includes DAU, new/returning split, session counts, average session length, and D1/D7/D30 retention percentages. combo_fighter from 2025-12-27, domino_delights from 2023-11-01. Zombie Match 3D is ABSENT BY DESIGN and its absence is a fact about the company, not a gap: it never had a DAU instrument. Derive ZM3D volume from ANALYTICS.MARKETING.INSTALL_EVENTS and ANALYTICS.GAME_EVENTS.USER_COHORT_RETENTION instead. Do not synthesise a ZM3D DAU series. Aggregated upstream of the retained event tables. RAW_GAME_EVENTS and STG_EVENTS_ENRICHED retain a 1:8 session sample, and PROGRESSION_EVENTS, SESSION_LEVEL_EVENTS and AD_IMPRESSION_EVENTS a 1:16 sample, so a recount from those tables will not match these totals.

Aggregated upstream of the retained event tables. RAW_GAME_EVENTS and STG_EVENTS_ENRICHED retain a 1:8 session sample, and PROGRESSION_EVENTS, SESSION_LEVEL_EVENTS and AD_IMPRESSION_EVENTS a 1:16 sample, so a recount from those tables will not match these totals.

tables.name: MONTHLY_BURN
tables.comment: Monthly cash burn by expense category, 239 rows across 35 months. 35 months here vs 34 in FINANCE.EXPENSES.CASH_BALANCE is not a disagreement: 2026-02 accrued $15,717.28 of burn but never reached a month-end close, so it has a burn row and no cash row. Peak monthly burn $158,557 (2024-09). From 2025-10 the post-downsizing run-rate is $15,717-$58,115/month; the wind-down decision was 2026-02-09.

columns.name: month
columns.comment: First day of month

columns.name: category
columns.comment: salaries | contractor_fees | aws_hosting | marketing | legal | tools_software | art_outsourcing | other

columns.name: headcount_impacted
columns.comment: salaries rows: NON-FOUNDER PAYEES active in that month (= CASH_BALANCE.headcount; company.headcount_peak_paid.scope). contractor_fees rows: non-founder CONTRACTORS active in that month. 0 for non-payroll categories. Founders are on the roster and are NOT in either count - see PAYROLL_ROSTER.is_founder

tables.name: CASH_BALANCE
tables.comment: Month-end cash position, 34 closed months 2023-04..2026-01. Key milestones: the seed round totals $3.00M across 8 entries, the largest a $2.70M wire from the lead investor; Jul 2025 month-end ($286K, 3.6 months runway); final closed month 2026-01 ($8K). The wind-down was initiated 2026-02-09 and no February close exists, so the series ends at the last month the company traded.

columns.name: monthly_net_burn
columns.comment: CASH delta month-over-month, NOT operating spend. Reconciles to MONTHLY_BURN only as sum(MONTHLY_BURN categories) - revenue = monthly_net_burn. A residual remains in most months, up to ~$47K in either direction. It is NOT severance: the termination letters record earned wages only (independent-contractor agreements) and Oct-2025 payroll was $32,172 across 9 people. Treat it as unexplained cash movement in a P&L that stopped being maintained in 2025 -- its UA row omits $46,201.50 of bank-confirmed wires.

columns.name: headcount
columns.comment: NON-FOUNDER PAYEES at that month end - the population company.headcount_peak_paid and company.headcount_actual_tail both count, and it reads 16 at the 2024-09 peak. COMPOSITION, because the total alone misleads: it is non-founder FULL-TIME staff PLUS non-founder CONTRACTORS, counted as distinct people - 2024-09 is 12 full-time + 4 contractors, and 2026-01's 4 is 2 + 2. Only the three co-founders are excluded, so ALL PEOPLE = this + 3, peaking at 19. That 19 is the warehouse's answer to company.headcount_peak_concurrent, whose quoted "21 people including contractors" is kind=REPORTED with a band of 19-21 - 21 is the top of that band, not a realised count

tables.name: HEADCOUNT
tables.comment: Employee roster with monthly cost, 371 rows (one per employee per cost regime; employee_id is NOT unique). 3 founders and 19 non-founder staff over the company's life. Non-founder payees peaked at 16, reached in 2024-09 and 2025-04 and fell to 8 in 2025-11. That payee count is non-founder FULL-TIME plus non-founder CONTRACTORS (13 and 6 distinct people over the company's life); only founders are outside it, so ALL PEOPLE peaked at 19; the tail runs 2025-09 12, 2025-10 13, 2025-11 8, 2025-12 7, 2026-01 4. Separately, one engineer was terminated 2025-10-20 for undisclosed dual employment (moonlighting) at a second company; that individual is anonymized and NOT identified in this roster.

Recorded incidents against these events -- 2024-11-15 Weekly Quests: Quest-system auto-deploy incident (ENG-1892); 2025-07-12 River Rush: Scheduler outage; 2025-08-05 Plague Race: Plague Race algo bug (ZOM-459).

tables.name: RESOURCE_FLOW_EVENTS
tables.comment: Sink/source ledger for the in-game economy, 1,483,075 rows: one row-set per PLAYER_DAILY_PROGRESS player-day. Not a sample. Currency movements present: bones source 9,556, coins sink 31,882, coins source 1,441,637. Booster prices as transacted: draw_3 1200, draw_5 1800, dynamite 1000, glue 400, gust 2000, rewind 500, trampoline 200, wildcard 1600. Combo Fighter is absent by design -- its prototype economy is not modelled in this ledger, and PLAYER_DAILY_PROGRESS does not credit it either, so the two agree. SCOPE: this ledger records soft-currency flows (coins) and the ZM3D bones faucet only. Gem-denominated purchases are NOT recorded here: the gem catalogue is real and priced in the shipped client, but no gem economy is simulated in this warehouse, so the absence of gem rows is a modelling boundary and not evidence that gems were unused.
